quality_rules: ## Non-Negotiable Rules (ALL agents) - ALWAYS read the manifest before making ANY edits. Never edit blind. - Source video is NEVER modified. All edits are manifest operations. - transcript.json is auto-synced after every manifest trim/split/remove. Trust it. - Scene files use Scene{N}.tsx naming (Scene1.tsx, Scene2.tsx, etc.). - Audio and video items from the same source are married — every split/trim/remove on one must be applied identically to the other. - After writing or modifying .tsx files, call trigger_rebuild. - Use render_still to verify visual changes.
